claim_text: Creatine monohydrate has evidence for improving repeated high-intensity exercise capacity and strength/power outcomes in some training contexts; benefits depend on resistance training and do not imply universal need.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid automatic supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults undertaking strength or repeated high-intensity training.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food and/or supplemental sources; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet summarizes creatine evidence for strength and high-intensity exercise.
limitations: No protocol from this claim; kidney disease and other relevant conditions require review.
Exact source passages and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
